    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Archer
    Represents a playable PlayerCharacter of type ARCHER.
    Armor
    Represents an Armor item that can be equipped by a PlayerCharacter.
    CharacterEventListener
    Interface defining callbacks for key events related to a CharacterModel.
    CharacterModel
    Abstract class representing a character in the RPG game.
    CharacterSelection
    GUI window for selecting a player character and difficulty level in the RPG game.
    CharacterSelectionController
    Controller for the CharacterSelection view.
    CharacterSelectionInterface
    Interface for classes that need to handle character selection events.
    CharacterType
    Enumeration representing all the character types available in the RPG game.
    Crossbow
    Represents a Crossbow weapon that can be equipped by a PlayerCharacter.
    DelayTimer
    Utility class that allows delaying the execution of a Runnable action.
    Difficulty
    Represents the predefined difficulty levels available in the game.
    Dragon
    Represents a Dragon-type enemy.
    DropListener
    Interface defining the contract for objects that manage and respond to item drop events within the graphical user interface, typically involving equipment or inventory management.
    Enemy
    Represents a non-playable enemy character in the game.
    EnemySelection
    GUI window that allows the player to select an enemy to fight against.
    Equipable
    Represents an item that can be equipped by a PlayerCharacter.
    EquipmentController
    Handles user inputs (clicks, drag-and-drop) and mediates between the View (EquipmentWindow) and the Model (PlayerCharacter).
    EquipmentEventListener
    Interface defining callbacks for equipment-related events for PlayerCharacter instances.
    EquipmentPanel<T>
    Represents a customizable panel designed for a single equipment item (Armor, Sword, Potion, etc.).
    EquipmentWindow
    Represents the equipment selection window for a PlayerCharacter.
    ExperienceProgressBar
    A custom JProgressBar that displays the user's current level and experience progress.
    GameController
    Controller managing the main game flow, specifically within the GameWindow.
    GameWindow
    Represents the main battle interface (View) of the RPG game.
    Goblin
    Represents a Goblin-type enemy.
    HealthPotion
    Represents a Health Potion that can be used by a PlayerCharacter.
    HealthProgressBar
    A progress bar that displays a CharacterModel's health.
    Images
    Utility class providing static methods for loading and resizing image resources used throughout the application's graphical user interface.
    IntroductionController
    Controller for IntroductionWindow.
    IntroductionWindow
    Represents the introduction window of the RPG game.
    Item
    Represents a generic item that can be used or equipped by a PlayerCharacter.
    ItemLabel
    Custom JLabel implementation used within the equipment window UI.
    ItemType
    Enumeration defining the different categories of items that can exist and be used within the game, particularly those that can be equipped or consumed by a character.
    MessageController
    Controller responsible for managing message display in a MyFrame.
    MyFrame
    Base JFrame for the game UI.
    Orc
    Represents an Orc-type enemy.
    PlayerCharacter
    Represents a playable character in the game.
    Potion
    Abstract base class representing a Potion item that can be used by a PlayerCharacter.
    PowerfulPotion
    Represents a Powerful Potion that can be used by a PlayerCharacter.
    RoundButton
    Custom JButton implementation that renders itself as a fully rounded button.
    Session
    Singleton class that manages the current user session.
    Shield
    Represents a Shield that can be equipped by a PlayerCharacter.
    SpeedPotion
    Represents a Speed Potion that can be used by a PlayerCharacter.
    Stats
    Class representing the combat statistics of a character in the RPG game.
    Sword
    Represents a Sword that can be equipped by a PlayerCharacter.
    User
    Represents a user in the system, storing credentials and experience information.
    UserManager
    Manages user data and handles its persistence to and loading from a file system.
    UserManager.LoginResult
    Represents the result of a login attempt, providing a success flag and a corresponding message.
    UserWindow
    Login window used to authenticate or automatically create users.
    Warrior
    Represents a Warrior-type playable character.
    Wizard
    Represents a Wizard-type playable character.
